themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints surged to 17 this week versus a baseline of 0.5 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 3,300% spike (z-score: 23.33)—suggesting a coordinated campaign or enforcement gap in Ridgewood/Glendale that warrants immediate investigation.
evidence: 17 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 23.33 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
3,300% increase is the highest-magnitude spike in the dataset
reporting_angles: Is this a coordinated postering campaign (political, commercial, or activist) and which neighborhoods are hit hardest?
Interview Sanitation Dept. about response protocols for bulk illegal posting and whether resources are sufficient

themes_detail.label: Graffiti and Tree Vandalism Surge
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped to 4 this week (540% above the 0.6 weekly baseline), while illegal tree damage spiked to 6 last week (269% above baseline of 1.6)—overlapping new damage patterns suggest either organized vandalism or a breakdown in community safety enforcement.
evidence: 4 graffiti complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (540% increase, z-score: 3.94)
6 illegal tree damage complaints last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (269% increase, z-score: 3.94)
Two concurrent environment-related spikes suggest connected vandalism trend
reporting_angles: Walk affected blocks to document scale and pattern of graffiti; interview residents on safety perception
Are tree vandals targeting specific species or locations? Speak with Parks Dept. on enforcement response

themes_detail.label: Encampments and Unsanitary Conditions
themes_detail.summary: Homelessness-related complaints accelerated over the past 2 weeks: 7 encampment reports (460% above 1.2 weekly baseline) and 3 unsanitary animal complaints on private property (300% above 0.8 weekly baseline)—both indicating emerging street conditions and possible sanitation issues near vulnerable populations.
evidence: 7 encampment complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.2 weekly average (460% increase, z-score: 4.8)
3 unsanitary animal on private property complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (300% increase, z-score: 5.2)
Concurrent spikes suggest linked homelessness and sanitation crisis
reporting_angles: Locate and interview people experiencing homelessness in encampments; map locations and services available
Interview Dept. of Homeless Services and NYPD on outreach efforts and whether resources are adequate for this district

themes_detail.label: Infrastructure Decay: Sidewalks and Sewers
themes_detail.summary: Root, sewer, and sidewalk condition complaints jumped to 15 last week (179% above 5.4 weekly baseline, z-score: 3.78)—a sharp spike suggesting either rapid deterioration or newfound resident attention to infrastructure failure in a district with long-standing DEP budget requests.
evidence: 15 root/sewer/sidewalk complaints last week vs. 5.4 weekly average (179% increase, z-score: 3.78)
Community Board has repeated budget requests for 'Inspect sanitary sewer on specific street segment and repair or replace'
Recent DEP capital request suggests systematic awareness of sewer/sidewalk issues
reporting_angles: Identify which streets have deteriorated most; obtain DEP records on sewer repairs and backlog in CD405
Interview residents on trip hazards and broken sidewalks; quantify repair request wait times from 311

themes_detail.label: Vendor Enforcement Activity Surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor enforcement complaints spiked to 7 two weeks ago (700% above 0.9 weekly baseline, z-score: 5.82)—a high z-score spike that may reflect either intensified street vending enforcement or emerging vendor-related complaints in the district.
evidence: 7 vendor enforcement complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 5.82)
Spike is isolated to one week with no sustained follow-up complaints reported since
reporting_angles: Was there a targeted enforcement operation 2 weeks ago? Interview DOH and Street Vendor Advisory Board
Are vendors complaining of harassment or citing licensing barriers? Speak with street vendor advocacy groups
